raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY • Experienced Business Analyst with 7+ years of experience in Capital Markets and Investment Banking.
Expertise in trade lifecycle analysis, hedge fund accounting, equity derivatives, financial reporting, and stakeholder management. Skilled in BRD/FRD documentation, SQL data analysis, UAT coordination, Agile delivery, and process improvement.
raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE

State Street Corporation Business Analyst – Capital Markets
Bengaluru, India Aug 2021 – May 2025
Collaborated with Front Office, Middle Office, and Back Office stakeholders to gather and document business requirements for capital markets platforms.
Created detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Functional Requirement Documents (FRD) ensuring alignment between business and technology teams.
Supported Agile delivery cycles, participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release coordination.
Coordinated User Acceptance Testing (UAT), test planning, and defect tracking to ensure systems met business requirements.
Conducted SQL-based data validation and reconciliation to ensure accuracy of financial data across trading and reporting systems.
Managed defect tracking using Jira, working with development teams to resolve issues efficiently.
Facilitated communication between business users and development teams to ensure alignment on project scope and deliverables.
Identified process bottlenecks and recommended automation and workflow optimization solutions to improve operational efficiency.
Worked on trade and transaction reporting, reconciliation processes, and operational support activities within Capital Markets domain.
Supported change management activities including user training, documentation updates, and post-production support.
Delivered training and documentation to end users improving system adoption and operational efficiency.

Design Cafe Manager – Finance
Mumbai, India May 2019 – Jun 2020
Worked as a Business Analyst in Capital Markets projects, gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements across front, middle, and back-office functions.
Demonstrated strong knowledge of financial market asset classes including Equities, Fixed Income, Derivatives, Foreign Exchange (FX), and Mutual Funds.
Collaborated with trading, operations, compliance, and technology teams to support end-to-end trade lifecycle processes from trade capture through settlement and reporting.
Led financial reporting and operational improvements reducing reporting turnaround time by 30%.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to implement new financial systems and reporting processes.
Managed monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close activities ensuring compliance and accuracy.
Conducted process analysis and system improvements to enhance operational efficiency.
Facilitated Agile sprint planning and coordinated finance technology initiatives.
Worked closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technology teams to translate business needs into functional specifications and user stories.
Supported end-to-end trade lifecycle processes including trade capture, validation, settlement, reconciliation, and reporting.
Conducted requirement elicitation workshops, stakeholder interviews, and gap analysis sessions to identify process improvements and business needs.
Prepared detailed BRD, FRD, process flow diagrams, workflow documentation, and use cases to support project delivery.
•
ICICI Securities Ltd. Equity Advisor and Fund Analyst
Mumbai, India Jan 2017 – Mar 2019
Demonstrated strong knowledge of financial market asset classes including Equities, Fixed Income, Derivatives, Foreign Exchange (FX), and Mutual Funds.
Analyzed and documented end-to-end trade lifecycle processes, including trade capture, validation, confirmation, clearing, settlement, and post-trade reporting.
Gathered and translated business requirements for trade lifecycle system enhancements, ensuring seamless integration across front-, middle-, and back-office platforms.
Analyzed Net Asset Value (NAV) and fund performance data for portfolio evaluation.
Maintained and validated counterparty and financial datasets ensuring data integrity.
Utilized SQL and data analysis techniques to support investment and reporting insights.
Collaborated with trading and research teams to interpret market data and investment trends.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to implement enhancements for Fixed Income and Equity trading platforms.
Assisted in regulatory and compliance-driven change initiatives by analyzing impacts and coordinating implementation activities.
Supported Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, and UAT coordination.
Created and executed UAT test cases, tracked defects, coordinated issue resolution, and ensured successful business sign-off.
Performed data analysis and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency across trading and operational systems.

Aditya Birla Sunlife Insurance. Insurance Sales Trainee
Mumbai, India Apr 2016 - Sep 2016
Advised customers on life and health insurance products, aligning policy recommendations with individual requirements.
Conducted customer outreach and policy consultations, supporting sales targets through effective relationship management.
Processed policy applications and documentation, ensuring accuracy and adherence to regulatory standards.
